text: Based on the Earth-observation evidence, there was no detected fire on the rural property (ASSET-F01) during the period from September 23, 2026, to October 23, 2026. The assessment was conducted using multiple sensors (VIIRS_SNPP, VIIRS_NOAA20, VIIRS_NOAA21, and MODIS), and no thermal anomalies were detected within the asset's boundary. However, it's important to note that small, short, cool, or cloud-obscured fires might not have been detected.
